lines.en: I step the way a Zorp steps.

lines.zh: 脚落在月尘上，轻轻一下。
lines.en: My feet touch moon dust lightly.

lines.zh: 我走路的样子，学得很像。
lines.en: I have learned to walk just like one.
Do not step on your own shadow.
I skirt the crater, pretending I know the way.
The moon is light; I walk slowly.
I hold my stride back so nothing shows.

lines.zh: 前面有块石头，我跨过去。
lines.en: A rock ahead; I step over it.

lines.zh: 我和真正的卓普走同一边。
lines.en: I walk on the same side as real Zorps.
My hat slipped; I straighten it and walk on.

lines.zh: 这片月面，我闭眼也会走。
lines.en: I could cross this moon with eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可一直不停。
lines.en: My pace is slow, but it never ends.

lines.zh: 我站着，摆出卓普的姿势。
lines.en: I stand in the pose a Zorp would hold.

lines.zh: 一动不动，才不会被看穿。
lines.en: Holding still keeps me from being seen through.
I rehearse my lines in my head.

lines.zh: 月亮挂在天上，冷冷的光。
lines.en: The moon hangs cold and bright above.
Someone passes; I hold my breath.
I adjust the angle of my mask.
A Zorp is hopping far away.
I watch through a gap to see how it moves.
This borrowed hide is stuffy.
I must remember not to smile.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，是看出什么了？
lines.en: You stare; have you noticed something?
I look at you the way it would.
Not too close; you will smell the difference.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的次数都算好了。
lines.en: I have counted how often to blink.
Why laugh? What part of me looks wrong?

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，音调刚练过。
lines.en: I cry out, using the pitch I practiced.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有一点怀疑。
lines.en: There is a trace of doubt in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，像它那样。
lines.en: I lower my head the way it does.
You watch me; I watch you too.
Do not ask me what my name is.
What you struck was a fake hide.
I back off and straighten my mask first.

lines.zh: 这一下让我叫得像真的。
lines.en: That made my cry sound genuine.
The pain is real; the skin is fake.
I grit my teeth and keep pretending.
Your sword opened a long gash.
The stitching split; I press it shut.
I stagger once, then steady myself.
Do not look inside me. Do not.
That cry slipped out without pretense.

lines.zh: 你手里的月石，能给我吗？
lines.en: Could you give me that moonstone?

lines.zh: 我不该贪，可那东西真亮。
lines.en: I should not covet, but it shines so.
Something sweet reaches my nose.

lines.zh: 月尘落在我肩上，我忘了拍。
lines.en: Moon dust settled on me and I forgot to brush it.
Higher, please; I cannot see it yet.
If I reach for it, I give myself away.

lines.zh: 这味道让我咽了口口水。
lines.en: That scent makes me gulp.
You shared a few crumbs with me.
I pretend I do not want it.
Just one bite, I promise not to be greedy.

lines.zh: 撞上的那一刻，我僵住了。
lines.en: At the moment of impact, I freeze.
Do not push; my hat brim is slipping.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我学它叫。
lines.en: We collide; I make its cry.
I back off and check your face.

lines.zh: 你的肩碰到我缝的外皮。
lines.en: Your shoulder touches my stitched hide.

lines.zh: 这一撞，差点把面具撞歪。
lines.en: That bump nearly knocked my mask askew.

lines.zh: 我假装是它不小心撞的。
lines.en: I pretend it was it who bumped you.
This body is light; do not push hard.
I counted my steps and still collided.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我们各走各路。
lines.en: Step aside; we will go our own ways.

lines.zh: 它在月亮上等了我很久。
lines.en: It waited for me a long time on the moon.

lines.zh: 我不敢在它面前脱这身皮。
lines.en: I dare not shed this skin before it.

lines.zh: 两个影子挨着坐在坑边。
lines.en: Two shadows sit together by the crater.
Who will our children take after?

lines.zh: 它信我是卓普，这就够了。
lines.en: It believes I am a Zorp; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我替它理了理背上的毛。
lines.en: I smooth the fur on its back.

lines.zh: 月亮上没有别人，只有我们。
lines.en: No one else on this moon but us.
It sleeps; I keep my eyes open.

lines.zh: 我怕它哪天发现我的脸。
lines.en: I fear the day it sees my face.

lines.zh: 夜里我们靠在一起，谁也不暖。
lines.en: At night we lean together, neither warm.
A moonstone lies here; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 这根毛不是我的，我藏起来。
lines.en: This hair is not mine; I hide it.

lines.zh: 我低头捡东西时，帽子滑了。
lines.en: Bending to pick it up, my hat slid.

lines.zh: 掉下来的是它的鳞片吗？
lines.en: Did it drop this scale?
I tuck the shard into a seam.
You dropped this; I will keep it.
This color is much like the moon.
I pick it up fast, afraid of being seen.
No one noticed, so I hide it in my sleeve.
One bend and my disguise shows a flaw.

lines.zh: 你不是卓普，我认得出来。
lines.en: You are not a Zorp; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你的味道不对，太新鲜了。
lines.en: Your smell is wrong, too fresh.
I no longer need to pretend.
An outsider has come to the moon.

lines.zh: 你看见我弯腰的样子了。
lines.en: You saw me bend the wrong way.

lines.zh: 既然你猜到了，那就别走。
lines.en: Since you guessed, do not leave.
I peel off half the mask.
Your heartbeat has gone irregular.
It will not come to save you.

lines.zh: 我在月尘里跟了你很久。
lines.en: I followed you a long way through moon dust.
Pretending this long has tired me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在坑边，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow fell by the crater; I saw it.

lines.zh: 现在你知道我是什么了。
lines.en: Now you know what I am.

lines.zh: 别喊，这里没有别的卓普。
lines.en: Do not shout; there are no other Zorps here.

lines.zh: 你的灯照过来，皮就掉了。
lines.en: Your lamp comes near, and my skin comes off.
I stop pretending, and you stop leaving.
I skirt the crater and circle toward you.
I still smile; beneath the mask I do not.

lines.zh: 你的剑举起来了，真聪明。
lines.en: You raise your sword; very wise.
I am short, but my arms reach far.

lines.zh: 月亮没有风，你听得到我。
lines.en: No wind on the moon; you can hear me.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪，装得像在散步。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, pretending to stroll.
You back to the crater; no way out.
I am in no hurry to strike.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在头盔里很响。
lines.en: Your breath is loud inside your helmet.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不看你的眼。
lines.en: I study your hands, never your eyes.
I have worn this skin a long time.

lines.zh: 你以为它不会攻击你吗？
lines.en: Did you think it would not attack you?

lines.zh: 月亮把我们的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: The moon stretches both our shadows long.
One more step and I stop pretending.
I walk slowly, as if I just woke.

lines.zh: 你的剑很快，我的皮很韧。
lines.en: Your blade is quick; my hide is tough.

lines.zh: 我先站到你右边，那边空。
lines.en: I take your right side, where you are open.
The crater rim is narrow; you can only come forward.

lines.zh: 月球上，你跑不出我的视线。
lines.en: On the moon, you can't outrun my gaze.

lines.zh: 月尘沾在我脚上，没声音。
lines.en: Moon dust keeps my steps silent.
I practiced this claw strike a long time.
A row of teeth shows beneath the mask.

lines.zh: 你后仰的时候，我补了一下。
lines.en: As you reel back, I strike again.
I aim for the seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 这个声音不像卓普，对吧？
lines.en: That cry was not a Zorp's, was it?
I ram my head into your chest.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的皮，里面是空的。
lines.en: You cut my hide; it is hollow inside.
I clamp my hand around your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下带着月尘的味道。
lines.en: This blow carries the taste of moon dust.

lines.zh: 你疼的时候，我笑出了声。
lines.en: When you hurt, I laugh out loud.
My claws are harder than they look.
You retreat two steps; I follow close.
Do not expect me to hold back.
This strike I make on its behalf.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的披风往回拽。
lines.en: I catch your cloak and pull.
This one lands beside your knee.
I put my elbow under your chin.
My claws slipped, but I am still smiling.
I shove you over the crater rim.
You cover your face, so I hit your gut.
I rise out of the moon dust.
This skin was prepared long ago.
The moon has one more Zorp now.
First I practice its cry twice.

lines.zh: 坑边太显眼，我换了个地方。
lines.en: The crater is too exposed, so I move.

lines.zh: 四下无人，我摘下帽子透气。
lines.en: No one around, so I lift my hat to breathe.

lines.zh: 我来得正好，有人落地了。
lines.en: Good timing: someone has just landed.

lines.zh: 月球的风很轻，几乎没风。
lines.en: The lunar wind is thin, almost none.
I shake the moon dust off my back.
The real Zorp hops in the distance.
I set out along its usual route.
From now on, I am it.
The hide curls at the edges, smelling strange.

lines.zh: 我从坑沿滑落，摔出一声闷响。
lines.en: I tumble off the crater rim with a thud.
There is no water on the moon; something is wrong.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻在月尘里。
lines.en: The blast flips me into the moon dust.
An arrow pins into my fake hide.
The spell passes the hide and burns within.
I starved a long time; that is why I am thin.
Lightning is rare on this moon.
Falling into void, even the skin is lost.
